meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会通过Linear频道自动参与issue评论：每当有新的评论时，它会自动回复，无需@提及。每个issue的评论线程会被当作独立的对话，Claude会在首次回复时向用户打招呼。
howto.when: 当被监控团队的任何issue收到新评论时触发。无需@提及，所有评论都会触发Claude回复。

say.text: 请总结这个 issue 的讨论要点。
say.note: Claude会在该issue评论区回复总结。

say.text: 针对Alex的评论，给出你的技术建议。
say.note: Claude会回复这条评论并给出建议。

say.text: 把这条评论的待办事项列出来。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically joins Linear issue comment threads: it replies to every new comment without needing an @mention. Each issue's comment thread is treated as a separate conversation, and Claude greets users when it first responds.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever a comment is added to an issue in the monitored team. No @mention required; all comments trigger a reply.

say_en.text: Summarize the key points of this issue discussion.
say_en.note: Claude replies with a summary in the issue comments.

say_en.text: Give your technical suggestion on Alex's comment.
say_en.note: Claude replies to that comment with advice.

say_en.text: List the action items from this comment.
